trait.name: Oathkeeper
trait.text: Start every fight with 6 Barrier and 6 Plating: your Barrier survives each turn up to your Plating, which shrinks by 1 a turn.

blurb: A knight of the Gilded Order. No companions: Might, Barrier and a deck that burns down to a point.
buildPaths: Might: hit many times, harder and harder
Consume: burn your own cards for value
Blood: pay HP for Mana, cards and Might
howTo: Barrier soaks damage, but it falls away at the start of your next turn. Your Plating keeps some of it through the first turns.
Exposed enemies take 50% more from your attacks: Sundering Blow sets it up.
Your cards come in many shapes: hit with your Barrier, pile up Might and hit many times, consume your own cards for value, or pay HP for Mana, cards and Might.
